proposal: F5('CHN', 'Jiangsu Rudong H5 (Yunshan) Offshore wind farm', 'mp', url='https://www.msa.gov.cn/msacncms_wap/pages/content.jhtml?articleId=b7613e4fc62c4362986860aaaf43ea99', zh='南通海事局 2020-09 施工航行通告：蘇交控如東H5#的施工內容為75台4 MW風機單樁基礎施工與75台風機安裝；2021-07 的後續通告（最後5台）施工內容同為4.0 MW風機單樁基礎。', en='Nantong MSA construction notice (Sept 2020): Jiangsu Communications Holding’s Rudong H5# works are 75 monopile foundations for the 4 MW turbines and installation of the 75 turbines; the July 2021 follow-up notice (last 5 units) also covers 4.0 MW monopile foundations.')
note_zh: 南通海事局 2020-09 施工航行通告：蘇交控如東H5#的施工內容為75台4 MW風機單樁基礎施工與75台風機安裝；2021-07 的後續通告（最後5台）施工內容同為4.0 MW風機單樁基礎。
note_en: Nantong MSA construction notice (Sept 2020): Jiangsu Communications Holding’s Rudong H5# works are 75 monopile foundations for the 4 MW turbines and installation of the 75 turbines; the July 2021 follow-up notice (last 5 units) also covers 4.0 MW monopile foundations.
why: Jiangsu MSA (Nantong) construction notices name 75 monopile foundations = all 75 x 4 MW turbines of the record. No post-completion depth/hub notice for H5 was found, so no D row (pre-completion depth 10–18 m from ne21 stays a lead).

farm: Jiangsu Rudong H2 (Guoxin) Offshore wind farm
proposal:
F5('CHN', 'Jiangsu Rudong H2 (Guoxin) Offshore wind farm', 'mp', url='https://www.msa.gov.cn/msacncms_wap/pages/content.jhtml?articleId=dce7f516f63a4f809dcc2907edf7a7fb', zh='南通海事局 2021-06 施工航行通告：如東H2# I標段（天津港航）40個機位、II標段（龍源振華）30個機位，施工內容均為單樁沉樁、防沖刷鋪設與風機安裝；2026-02 通航安全技術參數通告（已備案）：共70台5.0 MW。', en='Nantong MSA construction notices (June 2021): Rudong H2# lot I (Tianjin Port & Waterway, 40 positions) and lot II (Longyuan Zhenhua, 30 positions) both cover monopile driving, scour protection and turbine installation; the Feb 2026 navigation-parameter notice (filed after completion) gives 70 x 5.0 MW.')
D('CHN', 'Jiangsu Rudong H2 (Guoxin) Offshore wind farm', depth=(6, 21), url='https://www.msa.gov.cn/msacncms_wap/pages/content.jhtml?articleId=95b21f19c0724944936d34736da5d25c', zh='南通海事局 2026-02 通航安全技術參數通告（已備案）：海底高程 −21～−6 m（1985國家高程基準），以此作為水深範圍；70台5.0 MW；輪轂高度與葉輪直徑未寫。', en='Nantong MSA navigation-parameter notice (Feb 2026, filed after completion): seabed elevation −21 to −6 m (1985 national datum), used as the depth range; 70 x 5.0 MW; hub height and rotor diameter not stated.')
note_zh: 南通海事局 2021-06 施工航行通告：如東H2# I標段（天津港航）40個機位、II標段（龍源振華）30個機位，施工內容均為單樁沉樁、防沖刷鋪設與風機安裝；2026-02 通航安全技術參數通告（已備案）：共70台5.0 MW。
note_en: Nantong MSA construction notices (June 2021): Rudong H2# lot I (Tianjin Port & Waterway, 40 positions) and lot II (Longyuan Zhenhua, 30 positions) both cover monopile driving, scour protection and turbine installation; the Feb 2026 navigation-parameter notice (filed after completion) gives 70 x 5.0 MW.
why: Lot I 40 + lot II 30 monopile positions = all 70 turbines (post-completion notice confirms 70 x 5 MW). The depth is the seabed elevation against the 1985 datum, the same convention as the existing CGN Rudong H8 D row.

note_zh: 南通海事局 2020-11 施工航行通告：海安博潤新能源的蔣家沙50 MW項目施工內容為15個機位3.3 MW風機單樁基礎與風機安裝；2026-04 通告寫「禾望蔣家沙50MW風電場」機位更換葉片，已在運轉。
note_en: Nantong MSA construction notice (Nov 2020): Hai’an Borun New Energy’s Jiangjiasha 50 MW works are 15 monopile foundations for 3.3 MW turbines plus installation; an Apr 2026 notice (blade replacement at the ‘Hewang Jiangjiasha 50 MW wind farm’) shows it in operation.
why: 15 x 3.3 MW = 49.5 MW, matching the 50 MW record (GEM names Hai'an Borun New Energy as owner of this phase). The record's turbine field is empty; the notice gives 3.3 MW units. A July 2021 change notice only changed vessels and extended the schedule.
